Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly concluded that Cleveland Park station is the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. This error occurred because the Orchestrator failed to verify that the Cleveland Elementary School in question is not located near Cleveland Park station on the Red Line, but rather near the Eastern Market station on the Blue/Orange/Silver Line. This misidentification of the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School led to an incorrect calculation of the number of stops and ultimately resulted in the wrong answer.
